name: Moreruela de los Infanzones (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, red and yellow with a double-width red stripe charged with three yellow crowns, two above and one below.
history: The arms and municipal flag were approved by the full council of Moreruela de los Infanzones in its sessions of 12 July 2001 and 16 October 2001 respectively; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three vertical stripes in proportions 1/4, 1/2 and 1/4, the outer ones yellow and the central one red with three yellow crowns of infanzón placed two and one.

features.role: three crowns of infanzón, two above and one below
